summary_en: Correction to share cancellation notice issued 10 June 2026. Post-cancellation share count revised from 949,183,028 to 949,183,210 shares outstanding.
title_en: Correction - Partial Correction to 'Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares'
translation_en_brief: JX Advanced Metals Corporation issued a correction to its share cancellation notice on 12 June 2026. The original notice was released on 10 June 2026. The only substantive amendment is a correction to the reference figure for post-cancellation shares outstanding, which has been revised from 949,183,028 shares to 949,183,210 shares. The correction adjusts the expected share count following the cancellation program but does not disclose the number or yen value of shares cancelled in this filing, as this is a technical correction to a prior announcement rather than a new programme.
